idea-plugin.name: CollectionSync
idea-plugin.description:
Keep your Postman and Insomnia collections in sync with your code. CollectionSync discovers the REST endpoints declared in your Java project (Spring, JAX-RS/Quarkus and Micronaut), imports your existing Postman (v2.1) or Insomnia (v4) collections and shows you, endpoint by endpoint, which requests are missing, incomplete or orphaned. It designs the missing requests for you — happy path, method, path, body built from your DTOs, query/path parameters and headers — and lets you merge them into the collection and export it back to Postman or Insomnia.

Main Features

  • Endpoint Discovery: Scans Spring (@RestController, @RequestMapping...), JAX-RS/Quarkus (@Path, @GET...) and Micronaut (@Controller, @Get...) controllers to build the full list of REST endpoints in your project.
  • Collection Import: Import Postman v2.1 or Insomnia v4 collections (JSON and YAML) with faithful round-trip of scripts, auth, variables and responses.
  • Coverage Tracking: See which endpoints have no request, which requests are incomplete (missing params, headers or body) and which requests no longer match any endpoint.
  • Request Generation: Design requests for discovered endpoints with example bodies generated from your DTOs, path/query parameters and headers.
  • Collection Completion: Merge the generated requests into an imported collection without duplicates (preview with what will be added before saving).
  • Export: Export the collection as Postman v2.1 JSON or Insomnia v4 (JSON/YAML).
  • Integrated Tool Window: A dedicated panel with endpoint, collection and coverage trees, with direct navigation to the controller method.
